The map clearly shows me at (2,7) surrounded by walkable '.'. Yet I can't move. This suggests the notice board object at (2,7) is blocking my tile and the game engine refuses to move me off a blocked tile, OR there's a state issue.

Wait — the notice board is listed at (2,7) "blocks". The map doesn't show 'o' at (2,7) because I'm there ('@' overrides). So I'm standing on a blocking object. The engine may be preventing movement because... actually normally you can walk off.

Let me try a different approach: maybe the game needs the player to move first, or maybe I should try pressing E to "read" the notice board which might relocate me. Let me face the notice board — it's on my tile. Let me try pressing E in each direction to find it.
